email.body1:
Dylan, saw Prove launch its Verified Agent Solution and Global Identity Graph, plus the authID and Backbase partnerships.

Shipping that much usually opens more in-market accounts than the team can cover, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Prove off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Dylan, quick follow-up for Prove.

With new products and partnerships driving demand, the pipeline target usually outpaces what the team can cover. Most directors cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Prove needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Dylan, last bit of proof for Prove.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Prove's reply rate likely compares to other identity-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Dylan, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A heavy product-launch stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Prove either way.
